   - `isDirty` state tracking for unsaved form changes
   - `localStorage` for persisting dismissible onboarding state

     declare module "*.css";
     declare namespace JSX {
       interface IntrinsicElements {
         "s-save-bar": React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> & { id: string }, HTMLElement>;
         "s-app-nav": React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, HTMLElement>;

       }
     }

     - Added `isDirty` tracking comparing current values against loader data
     - Removed `<s-save-bar>` and all related event listener useEffects
     - Current Page component setup:
     ```typescript
     primaryAction={isDirty ? {
       content: "Save",
       onAction: handleSaveAll,
       loading: isSaving,
     } : undefined}
     secondaryActions={isDirty ? [{
       content: "Discard",
       onAction: handleDiscard,
     }] : []}
     ```

   - **`app/routes/app.widget.tsx`** — Replaced Banner+Page primaryAction save pattern with conditional Page actions
     - Removed `<s-save-bar>` markup and all `shopify.saveBar` API calls
     - Added `handleDiscard` callback to reset all form state to loader values
     - Removed `console.error` from `syncConfigMetafield` function
     - Current Page component:
     ```typescript
     primaryAction={isDirty ? {
       content: "Save Changes",
       onAction: handleSave,
       loading: isSaving,
     } : undefined}
     secondaryActions={[
       ...(isDirty ? [{ content: "Discard", onAction: handleDiscard }] : []),
       { content: "Reset to Defaults", onAction: handleReset },
     ]}
     ```

   - **`app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`** — Changed error handling from toast to Banner
     - Removed `shopify.toast.show(data.error, { isError: true })` 
     - Added `actionError` variable and `Banner tone="critical"` at top of page content:
     ```typescript
     const actionError = data && "error" in data && data.error ? (data.error as string) : null;
     // In JSX:
     {actionError && (
       <Layout.Section>
         <Banner tone="critical" title="Billing error">
           <Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">{actionError}</Text>
         </Banner>
       </Layout.Section>
     )}
     ```

1 question do you think for database edge function and all we should use supabase ?

For a Shopify app like this, **no — stick with a plain PostgreSQL database on Railway**. Here's why:

**Supabase is overkill here:**
- You don't need edge functions — your app already has server-side loaders/actions via React Router
- You don't need Supabase Auth — Shopify handles all auth via session tokens
- You don't need Supabase Realtime — no live updates needed
- You'd be paying for features you'll never use
- Adds complexity (another service, another dashboard, another set of credentials)

**Railway PostgreSQL is the right fit because:**
- Prisma connects directly to PostgreSQL — zero extra config
- Your app and database live on the same platform — low latency
- Simple setup: Railway auto-provisions `DATABASE_URL`
- You only need basic CRUD operations (zip codes, rules, waitlist, subscriptions)
- Scales fine for thousands of Shopify stores

**When Supabase would make sense:**
- If you were building a multi-tenant SaaS with its own auth system
- If you needed real-time features (live dashboards, chat)
- If you needed edge functions for a separate API layer
- If you wanted Row Level Security at the DB level

**Bottom line:** Your stack (React Router server + Prisma + PostgreSQL on Railway) is exactly right for a Shopify app. Keep it simple.

RUN npm ci

# Prisma generate needs DATABASE_URL at build time (not used for connections)
ENV DATABASE_URL="postgresql://placeholder:placeholder@localhost:5432/placeholder"
RUN npx prisma generate
RUN npm run build

# Stage 2: Production runtime (only production deps)
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
RUN apk add --no-cache openssl

WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production

COPY package.json package-lock.json* ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev && npm cache clean --force

# Copy Prisma schema + generated client from builder
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/.prisma ./node_modules/.prisma
COPY --from=builder /app/node_modules/@prisma ./node_modules/@prisma
COPY --from=builder /app/build ./build
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY prisma ./prisma

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["npm", "run", "docker-start"]

// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long
// enough when changing adapters.
// See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/reference/prisma-schema-reference#string for more information
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Session {
  id                   String   @id
  shop                 String
  state                String
  isOnline             Boolean
  scope                String?
  expires              DateTime?
  accessToken          String
  userId               BigInt?
  firstName            String?
  lastName             String?
  email                String?
  accountOwner         Boolean?
  locale               String?
  collaborator         Boolean?
  emailVerified        Boolean?
  refreshToken         String?
  refreshTokenExpires  DateTime?
}

model ZipCode {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  zipCode   String
  label     String?
  zone      String?
  message   String?
  eta       String?
  type         String   @default("allowed")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  codAvailable Boolean?
  returnPolicy String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, zipCode])
}

model DeliveryRule {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop          String
  name          String
  zone          String?
  zipCodes      String?  // comma-separated zip codes, or empty for "all in zone"
  minOrderAmount Float?
  deliveryFee   Float?
  freeShippingAbove Float?
  estimatedDays String?
  cutoffTime    String?  // e.g. "14:00" — orders after this go next day
  daysOfWeek    String?  // e.g. "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri"
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  priority      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([shop])
}

model WaitlistEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  email     String
  zipCode   String
  note      String?
  status    String   @default("waiting") // waiting, notified, converted
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, email, zipCode])
  @@index([shop])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id                    String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String  @unique
  // Layout
  position              String  @default("inline") // inline, floating, popup
  // Colors
  primaryColor          String  @default("#008060")
  successColor          String  @default("#008060")
  errorColor            String  @default("#D72C0D")
  backgroundColor       String  @default("#FFFFFF")
  textColor             String  @default("#202223")
  // Text
  heading               String  @default("Check Delivery Availability")
  placeholder           String  @default("Enter your zip code")
  buttonText            String  @default("Check")
  successMessage        String  @default("Great news! We deliver to your area.")
  errorMessage          String  @default("Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.")
  notFoundMessage       String  @default("This zip code was not found in our system.")
  // Features
  showEta               Boolean @default(true)
  showZone              Boolean @default(false)
  showWaitlistOnFailure Boolean @default(false)
  showCod               Boolean @default(true)
  showReturnPolicy      Boolean @default(true)
  showCutoffTime        Boolean @default(true)
  showDeliveryDays      Boolean @default(true)
  blockCartOnInvalid    Boolean @default(false)
  blockCheckoutInCart   Boolean @default(false)
  showSocialProof       Boolean @default(true)
  // Border
  borderRadius          String  @default("8")
  // Custom CSS
  customCss             String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model ShopSettings {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop              String   @unique
  defaultBehavior   String   @default("block") // "block" = block all unlisted zips, "allow" = allow all unlisted zips
  notificationEmail String?  // email to receive waitlist notifications
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
}
